name: No print for logging
rule: Never use print() for logging. Always use the logger module.

name: Parameterized SQL
rule: SQL queries must be parameterized. Never build them with f-strings or string concatenation.

name: Docstrings required
rule: Every function must have a docstring explaining what it does.

name: No hard-coded secrets
rule: Never hard-code passwords or API keys. Read them from environment variables.

name: Specific exceptions
rule: Catch specific exceptions. Never use a bare except.

name: Descriptive names
rule: Use snake_case and descriptive names. No single-letter names except loop counters.
